settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Battle of Moscow winter 1941 wartime newsreel footage. Snow forests, frozen trenches, visible breath, log villages, period-correct Soviet winter uniforms and rifles. Moderate grain, gate weave, fine scratches, dust, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, drone, gimbal, HDR or glossy modern polish.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A human wartime cameraman is physically embedded with the Soviet defenders and suffers the same snow, cold, shelling and restricted lines of sight. He trudges through snow, descends into trenches, slips slightly on ice, hides behind trees and walls, reacts late to shell bursts and cannot film from impossible safe positions. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated winter field-camera realism: snow on lens edge, frosted breath near camera, glove handling, uneven footing, short reactive pans, modest shake during shelling, near-still holds during cold waiting, imperfect focus in fog and blue dusk.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional Soviet rifleman anchors continuity while the unseen cameraman shares the same frozen positions.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute winter battlefield reenactment near Moscow in late 1941 as if a human war correspondent were embedded directly with Soviet defenders. Camera must obey snow depth, cold, cover, shelling and human reaction time. Follow forest approach, frozen trench, shelling, village movement, quiet recovery, night listening and another frozen dawn. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A Soviet rifleman moves through a snowy forest to a frozen line. Shelling drives everyone low, the section returns brief fire, shifts through forest and village positions, pauses in the cold and returns to the trench. Night and dawn pass over the same positions while the cameraman remains physically inside the defensive line.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP04 — Moscow 1941: Winter Resistance

scenes.title: Frozen Dawn
scenes.description: A Soviet section trudges through a snow-covered pine track.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman walks with shoulders hunched against cold.
scenes.imageDescription: Winter 1941, snow-laden pines, Soviet infantry, visible breath, black-and-white 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman trudges behind and beside the men at shoulder height; deep snow creates irregular heavy bounce and small slips. Breath occasionally hazes the lens. Audio: snow crunch, fabric, breath, wind, distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches trench approach behind the same section.

scenes.title: Frozen Trench
scenes.description: The section arrives at a shallow frozen trench.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman drops into trench and peers over snow lip.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow trench, icy timber, sandbags, Soviet defenders, breath vapor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator climbs awkwardly down behind him, camera tilts toward boots and icy timber, briefly soft-focuses, then settles below parapet. Lower view is blocked by trench wall. Audio: ice scrape, snow, breath, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains low in same trench.

scenes.title: Shells in the Snow
scenes.description: Artillery impacts farther along the line.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman ducks as snow showers into trench.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow plume from impact, defenders low, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Blast catches cameraman by surprise: sharp downward jolt, frame filled by snow and coat sleeve, momentary white blur and muffled sound, then low shaky recovery without standing. Audio: boom, debris, dull ringing, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Snow flecks remain at lens edge.

scenes.title: Answer Through Frost
scenes.description: Defenders return controlled fire toward distant treeline.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman fires briefly over parapet.
scenes.imageDescription: Frosted rifle, snow trench, distant dark trees, no close enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stays crouched, raises only enough to film over soldier’s shoulder. Helmet and trench lip block parts of frame. He ducks immediately after the firing beat. Audio: rifle shots, echo, wind, artillery.

scenes.title: Through the Pines
scenes.description: A small group reinforces a forest position.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest, dark trunks, low fog, troops moving under cover.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows behind tree-to-tree, never passes the soldiers. Trunks repeatedly occlude the image; one slip makes horizon cant before recovery. Audio: snow crunch, branches, breath, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator reaches village edge with group.

scenes.title: Village Fence
scenes.description: The unit takes cover behind a snow-covered fence and log wall.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman kneels and scans lane.
scenes.imageDescription: Frozen log houses, fence, haze and smoke, winter troops.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator crouches behind same fence; slats cut through foreground and limit sight. Small handheld pan follows the soldier’s gaze instead of floating above the fence. Audio: wind, wood creak, distant shots.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays low at fence corner.

scenes.title: Across the Icy Lane
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman runs across icy lane.
scenes.imageDescription: Snowy lane, packed ice, log walls, drifting smoke.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman waits a fraction behind then follows; boots slip slightly, camera swings toward ground, hand-corrects and stops hard behind house corner. Audio: sliding boots, gear, distant fire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator pressed behind same log wall.

scenes.title: A Minute of Snow
scenes.description: Firing fades and snow falls quietly.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman flexes stiff fingers and breathes.
scenes.imageDescription: Quiet snowy corner, exhausted soldier, rifle resting, no action nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman rests too: near-still human-held close view with breathing drift and occasional fog from operator’s breath crossing lens edge. Audio: wind, soft snow, breathing, very distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains beside soldier as comrade approaches.

scenes.title: Shared Scarf
scenes.description: A comrade helps tighten scarf and strap.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman stands still while gear is adjusted.
scenes.imageDescription: Two Soviet soldiers in snow, damaged village behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator notices the small human moment from one meter away; no staged dolly. One natural half-step closer, shoulder of helper partly blocks face. Audio: fabric, buckle, breath, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera turns as group heads back to trench.

scenes.title: Back to the Line
scenes.description: The section returns to same snowy trench.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman descends into earlier position.
scenes.imageDescription: Same trench, deeper boot marks, more churned snow, accumulated frost.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows the exact route down, briefly catching only backs and shoulders; camera bumps timber and resettles below parapet. Audio: snow, gear, wind, distant battle.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator returns to same low trench position.

scenes.title: Blue Dusk Flashes
scenes.description: Dusk turns snow blue-grey and distant flashes appear.
scenes.imageDescription: Dusk snow trench, dark tree line, distant flashes, breath vapor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still low camera held by cold hands; minor tremor and exposure breathing when flashes occur. No zoom. Audio: wind, distant intermittent fire, breathing.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains in fading trench light.

scenes.title: Night Listening Post
scenes.description: The rifleman listens among dark trees.
scenes.actionDescription: He stands near pine trunk with rifle lowered.
scenes.imageDescription: Night snow forest, faint sky glow, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crouches behind neighboring trunk; branches obscure half the view. A very slow lean is the only movement, with focus hunting in darkness. Audio: wind, branch creak, breath, distant battle.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator stays behind tree until dawn transition.

scenes.title: First Light Countermove
scenes.description: At dawn the section advances through fresh snow.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifleman follows comrades beyond previous tree line.
scenes.imageDescription: Pale dawn, fresh snow, tired infantry advancing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator trudges behind, breath louder, occasional low glance at footing; camera never overtakes the section. Audio: snow crunch, breath, equipment, distant guns.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stops at forest edge with village visible behind.

scenes.title: Village Still Standing
scenes.description: The rifleman looks back at battered village.
scenes.actionDescription: He pauses to study smoke rising from roofs.
scenes.imageDescription: Damaged snowy village, light smoke, soldier foreground profile.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman catches the backward glance and turns a beat late, branches and another soldier partially blocking panorama. Slight overshoot correction. Audio: wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Winter Resistance
scenes.description: The rifleman returns to defensive line as wind lifts snow.
scenes.actionDescription: He settles into trench and looks over field.
scenes.imageDescription: Wide snowy trench, windblown snow, exhausted defenders, no victory pose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator settles beside defenders and holds from human chest height, gloves causing tiny tremor; wind pushes snow across lens edge. No crane or dramatic pull-back. Audio: wind, breath, distant artillery only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame remains low in trench.

characters.name: Winter Rifleman
characters.description: Anonymous Soviet winter infantryman in historically plausible 1941 cold-weather field gear.

continuity.continuityRules: Keep same face, coat, headgear and rifle. Snow and frost accumulate gradually; no clean reset.
